title: Fires fueled by El Niño leave 12 dead in Peru

blocks.text: LIMA — Forest fires fueled by El Niño have killed 12 people and left hundreds homeless in Peru since June, authorities in the Andean country said Wednesday. Most of the victims were farmers who died of injuries sustained while trying to fight the flames, the National Emergency Operations Center, known by its Spanish acronym COEN, said. The worst-affected region was Cusco, where a fire broke out near the Inca citadel of Machu Picchu earlier this month. A total of 457 forest fires were recorded in Peru between June and October.
